provenance.dataset: FAOSTAT Production_Crops_Livestock, Bangladesh, yield / area harvested / production 1961-2024 (national, all seasons of each crop)
provenance.notes: Each record is one national harvest year. Good and bad years are judged against the crop trend in train_harvest_model.mjs. Season and months are the crop calendar in Bangladesh (BBS), set in build_harvest_records.py.

chili_dry.item: Chillies and peppers, dry (Capsicum spp., Pimenta spp.), raw
